name: AI for Hydrology Modeling
description: We introduce an AI-driven Transformer-based deep learning model to address data gaps in GRACE and GRACE Follow-On satellite data. By integrating meteorological and hydrological features like temperature, precipitation, and evapotranspiration, the model effectively fills the 11-month data gap, showing superior accuracy, particularly in arid regions. The transformer-based approach outperforms traditional methods, demonstrating the potential of AI in enhancing satellite data continuity and reliability for environmental monitoring.
related: ["Wang, L., & Zhang, Y. (2024). Filling GRACE data gap using an innovative transformer-based deep learning approach. Remote Sensing of Environment, 315, 114465. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rse.2024.114465"]
description_zh: 我们提出基于 Transformer 的人工智能深度学习模型，用于填补 GRACE 与 GRACE Follow-On 卫星观测之间的数据缺口。模型融合气温、降水和蒸散发等气象水文要素，有效填补约 11 个月的观测空缺，精度优于传统方法，在干旱区表现尤为突出，展示了人工智能在提升卫星数据连续性与可靠性方面的潜力。

name: CAS-Canglong
description: We present a novel AI-based approach for sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) global sea surface temperature (SST) prediction, using a 3D Transformer model called CAS-Canglong. By leveraging the self-attention mechanism inherent in Transformer architectures, the model efficiently handles the complexities of ocean-atmosphere interactions and improves prediction accuracy. Compared to traditional physics-based models, CAS-Canglong demonstrates superior skill in predicting SST patterns, enhancing computational efficiency and forecasting accuracy for up to three months in advance. This approach shows great potential for improving predictions of extreme weather events like droughts and floods, as well as for future climate studies.
related: ["Wang, L., Zhang, X., Leung, L. R., Chiew, F. H. S., AghaKouchak, A., Ying, K., & Zhang, Y. (2024). CAS-Canglong: A skillful 3D Transformer model for sub-seasonal to seasonal global sea surface temperature prediction (No. arXiv:2409.05369). arXiv. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2409.05369"]
description_zh: 我们提出面向全球海表温度次季节至季节（S2S）预测的人工智能方法——三维 Transformer 模型“中科苍龙”（CAS-Canglong）。模型利用自注意力机制刻画复杂的海气相互作用，与传统物理模式相比，在最长三个月的提前期内具有更高的海温预测技巧和计算效率，可为干旱、洪水等极端事件预报和未来气候研究提供支撑。

name: Drought Recovery and Hydrological Resilience
description: This research investigates how large river basins recover from severe droughts and why recovery varies across regions. By integrating GRACE satellite observations with global water availability estimates, we quantify terrestrial water storage recovery and identify pronounced disparities between humid and dryland basins. We further examine how post-drought water availability, recurrent droughts, and human water use influence recovery trajectories and long-term hydrological resilience.
related: ["Xu, Z., Zhang, Y., Blöschl, G., Wagener, T., AghaKouchak, A., Zhang, X., Wang, L., Tian, J., Ma, N., Li, X., Li, C., Huang, Q., Tang, Z., Yang, X., Xia, J., & Liu, C. (2026). Satellite evidence of unequal basin-scale recovery from severe droughts. National Science Review, nwag624. https://doi.org/10.1093/nsr/nwag624"]
description_zh: 本研究关注严重干旱后大型流域水文系统的恢复过程及其区域差异。通过融合 GRACE 卫星观测与全球水资源可利用量估算，量化陆地水储量恢复过程，揭示湿润与干旱流域之间显著的恢复差异，并进一步分析干旱后水分可利用量、重复干旱和人类用水对水文恢复及长期韧性的影响。

name: Fire Impacts and Cascading Hazards
description: This research examines how wildfires alter catchment water balance and intensify subsequent flood hazards. Studies in southeast Australia show that fire-induced vegetation and land-surface changes can modify evapotranspiration and streamflow, while amplifying flood peaks under certain hydroclimatic conditions. These findings highlight the cascading hydrological impacts of forest fires and their implications for flood risk.
related: ["Xu, Z., Zhang, Y., Zhang, X., Ma, N., Tian, J., Kong, D., & Post, D. (2022). Bushfire‐Induced Water Balance Changes Detected by a Modified Paired Catchment Method. Water Resources Research, 58(11). https://doi.org/10.1029/2021wr031013","Xu, Z., Zhang, Y., Blöschl, G., & Piao, S. (2023). Mega Forest Fires Intensify Flood Magnitudes in Southeast Australia. description_zh: 本研究关注林火如何改变流域水量平衡并加剧后续洪水灾害。在澳大利亚东南部的研究表明，林火引起的植被与陆面变化会改变蒸散发和径流，并在特定水文气候条件下放大洪峰。这些发现揭示了林火的级联水文影响及其对洪水风险的意义。

name: HBV-PML
description: The HBV-PML model, provides critical data support for global water resource assessments. This innovative model integrates the remote sensing evapotranspiration model PML with the classical hydrological model HBV, significantly improving the accuracy of evapotranspiration simulation through remote sensing observations. It effectively overcomes the limitations of traditional models in representing vegetation dynamics.
description_zh: HBV-PML 模型将遥感蒸散发模型 PML 与经典水文模型 HBV 相结合，利用遥感观测显著提高蒸散发模拟精度，克服了传统模型难以刻画植被动态的局限，为全球水资源评估提供关键数据支撑。
